At some point a '''member''' of the [[New Jedi Order]] traveled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] on a reconnaissance mission. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was captured by remnants of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], an order of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] that had served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the Jedi was imprisoned inside the [[Citadel Inquisitorius]]. There, the Inquisitors slowly began turning the Jedi to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and a rescue party was dispatched to free the Jedi. The Inquisitor [[Shynne]] greeted the rescuers when they arrived on Prakith and she planned to force the captured Jedi to fight them, as a final step to force the Jedi to submit to the dark side.
